items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-03
items.q: Shots played with us in the full place. I was playing with him.

ctx.x: Why not? Ask me if you knew shots.

Did you know shots? Shots, huh, Ruby? I was playing with him. Shots played with us in the full place. I was playing with him. Shots was another liquor-head, too. He was a good corner player, but he was a liquor-head. Shots drank so much whiskey to the kids. He played with us until he got kind of sick. And he wasn't sick so long before he died. He was a good corner player, Shots. Which band was that? Whose band? Well, we was a make-up band, I thought. We didn't have no special name. Then I was with, uh, called it…

items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1960-01-21
items.q: He played in the little Joe's place once.

ctx.x: Say, was he reliable? Yeah. Good, I... He played in the little Joe's place once. Joe had his teeth fixed, you know. Played about two weeks. People like to throw the place down in South Carolina, you know. They pay for white people, you know. Down on, uh... Clayborne and Frenchman. And then they stopped, they stopped them once. On the count of the, uh... You know, the people bring their children there. And that just made everything run down, you know. And then it opened up again that they could bring their…
